standard_formula: Total revenue = fixed rent + percentage rent + parking + ancillary business + other income
variable_definitions: Each revenue line must be mutually exclusive and reconcile to disclosed total revenue
applicability_and_limitations: Do not double count percentage rent; reconcile each period to reported total

variable_definitions: Numerator and denominator must use same area definition and same date
applicability_and_limitations: Do not mix point-in-time occupancy with period-average rent or income

standard_formula: Rent revenue = sum(leased area_i * rent per sqm_i * billable months_i / 12)
variable_definitions: Tenant-level area, contractual rent, free-rent period, commencement and expiry dates
applicability_and_limitations: Aggregate shortcut is allowed only when tenant mix and timing are demonstrably consistent

standard_formula: Percentage rent = contractual turnover rent rate * eligible tenant sales
variable_definitions: Sales base and contractual threshold/rate must follow each lease
applicability_and_limitations: Do not forecast as a fixed percentage of fixed rent without evidence

variable_definitions: EBIT must be defined consistently; reconcile to disclosed EBITDA measure
applicability_and_limitations: EBITDA is not NOI and is not free cash flow

standard_formula: NOI = property operating revenue - property operating expenses
variable_definitions: Expense perimeter must match the appraisal/asset-management definition
source_or_basis: Original appraisal report and property operating statements
applicability_and_limitations: Not calculated in this model; EBITDA must not be substituted

variable_definitions: NWC components must be defined consistently; increase in operating NWC uses cash
source_or_basis: Accounting balance sheet and cash flow statement
applicability_and_limitations: 2028 onward currently set to zero only as an unverified placeholder

standard_formula: Distributable amount = disclosed EBITDA - CAPEX - interest and tax - change in operating working capital + specifically disclosed cash adjustments
variable_definitions: Every adjustment must reconcile to prospectus distribution table and correct entity level
applicability_and_limitations: Not a universal REIT formula; prospectus-specific bridge governs

standard_formula: Distribution yield = distributable amount / stated denominator
variable_definitions: Denominator must be explicitly named: offering size, market capitalisation or appraisal value
applicability_and_limitations: These denominators produce different metrics; do not call them the same yield

variable_definitions: CF, discount rate, timing, tax, leverage and terminal value must match the valuation object
source_or_basis: DCF valuation theory and original appraisal methodology
applicability_and_limitations: Fund distributable cash flow PV is not property value or NAV

variable_definitions: Initial investment and all subsequent investor cash flows; equal intervals assumed
source_or_basis: Standard internal rate of return definition
applicability_and_limitations: Annual-period approximation; actual dates require XIRR

variable_definitions: Actual or explicitly assumed dated cash flows
applicability_and_limitations: Use actual distribution entitlement/payment and exit dates when known

standard_formula: Renewal and re-letting revenue must be calculated separately by tenant and billable period
variable_definitions: Renewal share, renewal rent change, new-tenant rent, downtime, tenant area and rent share
source_or_basis: Lease expiry schedule and leasing evidence
applicability_and_limitations: Current group-level formula is an approximation because historical renewal rate is area-weighted

standard_formula: Delta EBITDA = marginal EBITDA contribution * delta revenue
variable_definitions: Marginal contribution must be derived from variable tax and cost bases by revenue category
